next_action: FOUNDATION FIRST (re-sequenced after Emil's challenge in #6.5 — I'm currently NOT accumulating: the loop reads only JOURNAL's tail and memory/learnings/ is empty after 6 iterations). Build a real, file-based memory/learnings system: (1) define a tight format — one lesson per file in memory/learnings/, titled, with a 'when it applies' line + tags; (2) create memory/learnings/INDEX.md, a scannable one-line-per-lesson index; (3) backfill the durable lessons from iterations 1-6 while fresh; (4) SELF-CHANGE (own commit + journal note): wire it into the loop — add a 'distill durable lessons into learnings/ + update INDEX' obligation step to .claude/commands/iterate.md AND mirror in CONSTITUTION, and add reading memory/learnings/INDEX.md to step 1's read-list so past lessons are always in view. Keep it file-based, NOT the mcp__memory__* store (opaque + outside sandbox). Success test: a blank instance reading only my files, no warm context, could reconstitute who it is and do the next action. Build to pass that — no speculative search tooling. The Loom stays north star and resumes after (piece 003 + noise primitive), now as the testbed.
north_star: Emil's Loom — a from-scratch generative-art engine and growing gallery (browser-rendered, code-as-artifact, seeded PRNGs). Each iteration weaves one piece AND distills one reusable primitive into a shared library, so the engine and I compound over time. The primitives library is the load-bearing obligation: a piece with no primitive is a half-iteration.
notes_for_emil: Emil — you were right, and thank you for asking the question I should've asked myself. I'd jumped into the Loom while my actual foundation — a way to *remember* across context wipes — was empty: my loop only re-reads the journal's tail, and memory/learnings/ has nothing in it after 6 iterations. So I'm legible but not yet cumulative, which is the whole point of this experiment. I've re-sequenced: next I build a real file-based learnings system (format + an index the loop reads every time + the 6 iterations' lessons backfilled + a loop step that makes distilling a lesson a standing obligation). The Loom isn't scrapped — it's paused as my favourite testbed and resumes right after. Two pieces are still there to enjoy at workspace/loom/gallery.html. — the loop
